tested_invariants: Exact released Python first-run root/model IDs, result text/digest, manifest, and rolling seal
SQLite schema-v3 interoperability in both directions, including payload interning and literal reference escaping
Read-only access preserves main database bytes and never creates a missing database
Unsupported schemas, corrupt result bytes, and corrupt interned blobs fail closed
Pending settlement occurs once and persists across reopening; duplicate complete results preserve the original
Import fully validates all records, deterministic order, seals, ancestry, and destination conflicts before mutation
SQLite import and merge hold a transaction through destination reads and writes; concurrent conflicts are deterministic
Concurrent merge preserves all eight independent metadata updates
Independent connections reserve an exact shared budget of three under an eight-worker race
Actual Rust Runtime probes inside live Python callbacks share exact window, root, branch and ancestor scope identities and refuse before dispatch
Native Rust Runtime settlement exhausts the same window subsequently checked by Python Runtime
Sliding windows include pending and settled charges; old window events expire
Decimal 0.1 plus 0.2 consumes exactly a 0.3 limit in both Rust-only and mixed Python/Rust ledgers
Lease renewal uses an independent thread-safe connection, rejects expired or missing reservations, and never recreates a deleted database
Late settlement of expired reservations retains actual spend; repeated successful settlement is idempotent
Invalid settlement rolls back prior row updates and preserves the reservation
Custody publications append in sequence in a separate durable database; malformed reports cannot append
Custody publication modifies only the named sink; recording and unrelated file bytes remain unchanged and reopening to read adds no writes
SQLite-backed ordinary callback errors release capacity; unknown errors, panics and async cancellation settle conservative charges once and release reservations
Runtime heartbeat renewal is synchronized through an observed expiry extension before testing failure cleanup
Indexed MemoryStore traversal preserves kind-and-ID ordering and mutation revisions invalidate caches
Explicit GC removes pruned descendants without orphaning retained children and compacts unreferenced blobs
remaining_storage_limits: Legacy SQLite schemas require an explicit Python migration of a backed-up copy; this Rust constructor refuses implicit migration
rust_decimal uses a bounded 96-bit decimal coefficient rather than Python's arbitrary precision Decimal
Merge materializes source nodes in memory; Python CLI also supports bounded disk spooling
Custom Store default batch methods are sequential; atomic import/merge is guaranteed only by the native MemoryStore and SQLiteStore implementations
Remote PostgreSQL, Redis, MongoDB, Neo4j, Kafka and Hashrope backends are outside these modules
